subject: [PATCH v1 1/2] fuse: don't shorten the folio descriptor at LLONG_MAX

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the FUSE (Filesystem in Userspace) kernel module where the folio descriptor length is shortened when handling reads that exceed LLONG_MAX. This was causing issues with virtio-fs and iomap, leading to incorrect reporting of read bytes pending and leaving unrequested data in the folio. The patch leaves the descriptor length untouched, allowing the reply to be one byte shorter than expected, which is then zeroed out by fuse_copy_folios(). This fix also addresses a bug that existed before the introduction of iomap changes to FUSE.
